changes.to: Figures are from ZTE's WAIC 2026 launch release (July 2026). Weight is stated as '30-odd kg', recorded as 30. Tendon-driven lightweight frame with a soft lattice skin and bionic walking gait. DoF, payload, runtime and price are not published, and ZTE says the robot business has no material revenue yet.
Lightweight full-size bipedal commercial-service humanoid for reception, exhibition guidance and enquiries.
